0.question: How does a GrubGate subscription work?
0.answer: Our subscription service is designed for convenience. You pre-select your meal plan and schedule your deliveries for the week or on specific dates that work for you. Once set up, your delicious meals arrive automatically on the scheduled days.

1.question: Can I change the restaurant (our partner) for a scheduled meal?
1.answer: This flexibility is an exclusive benefit for our Premium subscription members. To ensure our partners have adequate time to prepare, any changes must be made at least 2 days before the scheduled delivery. Standard plan members cannot change the partner restaurant once a meal is locked in.

2.question: Do you offer one-time orders without a subscription?
2.answer: Yes! In addition to our subscription plans, you can also order single meals on-demand from our partner restaurants at any time. However, keep in mind that our subscription plans offer better value, with discounts for longer commitments like weekly or monthly plans.

0.question: How is my delivery time determined?
0.answer: Your delivery time is based on the schedule you set up with your subscription (e.g., your selected lunch or dinner slot). We deliver within that pre-agreed window, so you always know when to expect your meal.

1.question: Can I cancel or change a meal for a specific day?
1.answer: While individual meals cannot be fully canceled once your schedule is confirmed, you are able to modify your order. Standard plan members can swap their selected meal for another item of the same price from the same partner restaurant. We require any changes to be made at least 24 hours before the scheduled delivery.

0.question: Can I customize my meals for dietary needs like vegan or gluten-free?
0.answer: Absolutely. When selecting your meals or browsing our partner restaurants, you can use filters to find options that match your specific dietary requirements, including vegetarian, non-vegetarian, and more.

1.question: How often does the menu change?
1.answer: Our restaurant partners update their menus regularly to offer fresh meals. You'll see new and exciting meal options available to add to your plan each week.
